input_text: Life is a precious gift given to us by God . Life span of any human being is unpredictable . Some people live a long life while others enjoy a short span in this world . It is a great experience to lead a long life , but I believe quantity of life should have less weightage than the quality of time spent . It is undoubtedly true , people who are living their life to the fullest are the happiest . Also , they are not dependent on others for financial or physical support in their lifetime . Firstly , it is important to be happy and healthy throughout life . People who have less expectations , like a long life will try to live the time intensely following their dreams and experiencing happiness . For instance , going for vacations and travelling around the world frequetly in younger age present the feeling of excitement and energy in life , which can prove to be a stress buster and make a person happy . Secondly , living a short and fulfilling life gives the feeling of satisfied life . It is always encouraging to have a life which is not dependent on anyone else either financially or physically . To illustrate , human body starts deteriorating after a certain age and thus , needs support for performing day to day activities , the person also becomes incapable of earning and is interdependent , which can inculcate the sense of loneliness in life . In conclusion , it is like two swords in a case . People living a long life can earn many relationships and experience the change in generations throughout their life span , whereas the one with short and lively life can live his/her life independently to the fullest . Therefore , it is in my opinion that shorter and fulfilling life is better than a calm long life .
